title: Small defects and minor usability tweaks
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on small fit-and-finish defects, size-related complaints, and minor ergonomic or feature tweaks, while many fragments mention issues too briefly to determine a clear sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the car as too small, cite visible defects or poor trim fit, and mention specific material or range shortcomings.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews pair overall appreciation with limited complaints about trim fit or headrest comfort and adjustment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention small tweaks, irritating details, dents, lever size, or a small hole without enough context to confirm the reviewer’s overall sentiment.

limitations: Many fragments are very short or lack enough context to distinguish between mild criticism, factual reporting, and unclear sentiment.

The topic mixes several subthemes, including cabin or vehicle size, fit-and-finish defects, ergonomics, exterior dents, and isolated technical mentions, so it is not fully coherent as a single issue cluster.
Examples are limited to the supplied fragments, so they do not show whether one subtheme dominates beyond this sample.
